topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Got a tip about your college essay turnin' up as an example. Probably feel like you got caught in a echo chamber, words you wrote for private eyes only bouncing around public spaces. Thing is, got to play this smart. First, lay low. Figure out who leaked it or if it's just some clerical hiccup. Keep your cards close. If you want this wrapped up tidy, you gotta watch the angle you play. Could be an omen, or just another mystery in this town. What's sure, I've seen folks' best laid plans twist into something they never saw comin'. Gonna need facts before I put my hat on this one.
